visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and a thin build stands on a brown dirt baseball field at night. He wears a black baseball jersey with white piping and gold characters on the chest, a lanyard with multiple badges around his neck, and a black watch on his left wrist. He smiles broadly at the camera while holding up a red towel with white text that reads '是有的!!!' in a stylized font. Behind him, bright stadium lights illuminate the green grass of the outfield, a large electronic scoreboard showing game statistics, and a seated crowd in the distant stands. (2) The camera cuts to a profile shot of the man on the field. He is looking upward and laughing joyfully with his mouth wide open, raising his right arm high in a celebratory gesture. The background shows the stadium crowd in yellow and dark clothing, with pink ribbons or streamers scattered across the green grass of the field behind him, suggesting a championship celebration. The lighting remains bright from the overhead stadium floodlights.
